title: Which primary care networks a GP federation puts in the enhanced tier of its 2027-28 statin adherence service, on each network's 2026 share of its older self-managing statin patients under 80 per cent of days covered
subdomain: medication-adherence-persistence (a GP federation's enhanced tier for its statin adherence service, each primary care network's 2026 share of its older self-managing statin patients under 80 per cent of days covered, read from community pharmacy dispensing)
prompt_shape: cuts of a distribution per segment: twelve networks with each network's population and share fallen behind against the 30 per cent line, the closest network left out and its gap, a chart; and a table of the pilot's first consultations (October 2025 to September 2026) and six-week follow-ups by quarter in two networks

sources.origin: constructed for this task by task270/generator/build.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional English GP federation, its twelve primary care networks, their practices on two clinical systems, the community pharmacies and the integrated care board whose data service supplies the extracts, in the layouts of a health data service's dispensing extract and practice lists, a services portal export and a commissioner's payment statements; no real organisation's records or person is depicted.
